summary: Very steep kerb with homes 12-14 m away and resident-permit parking.

drivers.seclusion: Residential home 12 m away and apartments 14 m away on the same side; homes all round within 25 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along the kerb, so a van fits, but the road drops steeply the whole length.
drivers.convention: Cars park here; signs limit to 2P weekdays 7 am to 7 pm, resident permits excepted.

flags: Dwellings 10-25 m away on own side
sun_shade: Heavy tree cover along the east side; shaded from the west and midday.

best_section.where: East kerb of Woodstock Avenue, running downhill to the cross street
